rename.title: pleNx is now GMCA
rename.intro: Same app, all grown up. pleNx has become GMCA — the Gamepad Media Center Aggregator — and it does a whole lot more.
rename.feature_backends: One app, every server — Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Stremio
rename.feature_music: Your music library, right next to movies and shows
rename.feature_offline: Offline downloads to watch anywhere, no connection needed
rename.feature_updates: Regular updates, delivered straight to the app
rename.reassure: Your logins, settings and downloads came across automatically — nothing to set up again. Enjoy!

tutorial.error_a1:
1. Ensure the atmosphere and system firmware are up to date
2. Confirm that the system time is correct
3. Restore the default network settings, including IP, DNS, etc
4.Using in China
tutorial.error_a2:
1. Using a Fat32 format memory card
2. Ensure the atmosphere and system firmware are up to date
3. Waiting for developers to repair
tutorial.font_q1: How to set custom font or keymap icon
tutorial.font_a1:
1. Download the font or icon font you want
2. Rename font to: font.ttf; Rename icon to: icon.ttf
3. Place font files in the config directory
4. Restart the application
tutorial.font_a2:
1. GMCA prioritizes the display of custom fonts, with built-in fonts as a fallback
2. "Settings - Tutorial" provides a menu item to quickly open the config directory
3. On Linux, GMCA uses xdg-open to open the directory. If the configuration directory cannot be opened correctly, you can consider installing this tool

libraries.description: Reorder and hide the sidebar tabs (libraries, playlists, Watchlist). This setting is saved per server.

hidden_rows.description: Reorder and hide rows (Continue Watching, catalogs, …). Reordering applies to Home; hiding applies wherever a row appears — Home, the Movie/Show suggestion tabs, and their own catalog tabs. Shown rows always sort above hidden ones. This setting applies to every connection.

sub.player_loading_screen: Show loading screen until first video frame appears.
sub.player_loading_stages: Display step-by-step progress while the player is initializing.
sub.player_pause_screen: Show details overlay after 5 seconds while paused.
sub.player_osd_clock: Show current time and end time while controls are visible.
sub.player_osd_on_toggle: Show the on-screen controls whenever playback is paused or resumed.
sub.player_parental_guide: Show parental guidance overlay when playback starts.
sub.player_clip_point: Keep the last position for each file so playback resumes where it stopped.
sub.player_touch_gesture: Seek, change volume and brightness by dragging on the video.
sub.player_tv_model: Lay the on-screen controls out for a remote rather than a pointer.
sub.player_skip_intro_enabled: Show a Skip button when an intro, recap or outro is detected.
sub.player_introdb: Use introdb.app to detect intros and recaps.
sub.player_auto_skip_intro: Skip intros and anime openings automatically.
sub.player_auto_skip_outro: Skip outros and anime endings automatically.
sub.player_stream_autoplay_mode: Choose whether a source plays on its own, and which one.
sub.player_prefer_binge_group: Try the same source profile first (same addon/quality group) before normal auto-play rules.
sub.player_next_episode_card: Show the next episode prompt near the end of an episode.
sub.player_next_episode_autoplay: Start next episode automatically when prompt appears.
sub.player_next_episode_mode: When no outro timestamp exists, decide the prompt by percent or by minutes left.
sub.player_next_episode_percent: Fallback when no outro timestamp exists.
sub.player_next_episode_minutes: Fallback when no outro timestamp exists.
sub.player_still_watching: Ask before starting another episode once a run of them has played unattended.
sub.player_still_watching_threshold: How many episodes play back to back before the prompt appears.
sub.video_hwdec: Decode video on the GPU. Turn off if playback stutters or shows artefacts.
sub.mpv_vo: How decoded frames reach the screen.
sub.video_low_quality: Decode at reduced quality to keep playback smooth on slower hardware.
sub.video_inmemory: How much of the stream to keep in memory ahead of the current position.
sub.playback_audio_channels: Sets the speaker layout used for downmix.
sub.playback_audio_lang: Pick this language’s audio track when the file offers it.
sub.player_audio_delay_remember: Save and restore the in-player audio delay for the current audio output route.
sub.video_directplay: Always play the original file, never a server transcode.
sub.transcode_codec: The codec to ask the server to transcode into when direct play is not possible.
sub.playback_subtitle_lang: Pick this language’s subtitle track when one is available.
sub.playback_sub_secondary_lang: Fallback language when the preferred one is missing.
sub.player_sub_only_preferred: Hide all other subtitles languages from selection list.
sub.player_sub_use_forced: Prefer forced subtitles when audio matches subtitle language; if unavailable, select nothing.
sub.video_subs_fallback: Fall back to any available subtitle when none match your languages.
sub.player_sub_strip_sdh: Hide sound descriptions and speaker labels from text subtitles.
sub.player_sub_size: How large subtitle text is drawn.
sub.player_sub_offset: How far above the bottom edge subtitles sit.
sub.player_sub_bold: Use bold font weight for subtitles.
sub.player_sub_outline: Add outline around subtitle text for better visibility.
sub.player_sub_outline_width: How thick the outline around subtitle text is drawn.
sub.player_sub_text_color: The colour of the subtitle text.
sub.player_sub_bg_color: The colour of the box behind the subtitle text.
sub.player_sub_outline_color: The colour of the outline around the subtitle text.
sub.layout_show_hero: Display hero carousel at top of home.
sub.layout_fullscreen_hero: Expand the hero backdrop to fill the entire screen.
sub.layout_landscape_posters: Switch between portrait and landscape cards.
sub.layout_card_width: How wide a poster card is drawn in the rows and grids.
sub.layout_card_radius: How rounded the corners of a poster card are.
sub.ui_poster_labels: Show titles under posters in rows, grid, and see-all.
sub.layout_catalog_addon_name: Show source name under catalog titles.
sub.layout_catalog_type: Show type suffix next to catalog name (Movie/Series).
sub.layout_hide_unreleased: Hide movies and shows that haven’t been released yet.
sub.hidden_rows: Choose which catalog rows the home screen leaves out.
sub.libraries: Choose which of this server’s libraries the app shows.
sub.layout_show_ratings: Standard and TMDB ratings are shown on detail pages.
sub.layout_full_release_date: Show the whole release date instead of just the year.
sub.layout_episode_overlay_art: Choose the appearance shown when holding an episode.
sub.layout_stream_addon_logo: Show the source addon’s logo beside each stream.
sub.layout_show_continue: Show the Continue Watching row on the home screen.
sub.layout_cw_episode_thumbs: Use episode thumbnails as default image. When disabled, uses backdrop.
sub.layout_cw_next_up_furthest: Offer the episode after the furthest one watched, not the most recent.
sub.layout_cw_show_unaired: Keep a show in the row when its next episode has not aired yet.
sub.layout_cw_sort_mode: How the Continue Watching row is ordered.

hints.title: Launch GMCA as a full application
hints.text_applet: GMCA is running in applet mode: the available memory is not sufficient for video playback. Launch it as a full application using one of the options below.
hints.text_app: GMCA is running as a full application. Install the HOME menu tile to launch it this way directly.
hints.install_text: Installs the embedded NSP forwarder: the tile launches GMCA as a full application straight from the HOME menu.
hints.takeover_text: Hold R while launching any installed game to open the homebrew menu as a full application, then launch GMCA from there.
hints.prompt:
Install the GMCA tile on the HOME menu?
The tile launches the app as a full application (required for video playback).
hints.hint_confirm:
Installing NSP forwarder may result in a ban
Please confirm again
hints.remove_old: GMCA is on your HOME menu. If an old pleNx tile is still there, remove it from System Settings > Data Management > Delete Software.
